Anything positive said about this "game" is a blatant lie. One positive review mentioned "riding the dusty trails." Well, there are no dusty trails and there is no riding. You are stuck within the same limited one-town world where all the "action" takes place. For each girl in the town, there is a linear series of "quests" which involve no more than mindlessly running around on foot following your "compass" to visit certain hotspots (items or individuals to talk to). There are no puzzles to solve, no challenges, no brainpower required at all. Eventually you reach the end and get a sex scene with each girl. However, the quests are buggy -- at least one disappeared completely from the quest list and I was only able to complete it because there were still locations marked on the compass -- and the couple that require combat are hugely problematic. Why? Because the inventory system is buggy as well. Equipping and unequipping weapons does not work properly; if you work that out you have to shoot someone about 20 times to kill them before they kill you; the healing packs do NOT work; most of the inventory slots are for show only - there is no equipment in the game to make use of them. It's just a total ripoff of bugs and mindless effort. You get through the whole mess in a few hours tops, and there is no apparent ending. After the last available "quest" you're left with nothing to do, but no actual end to the game. I've now played several titles by this publisher, and they are ALL the SAME - and mostly so buggy that they couldn't be completed. In fact, each title I've tried has left me with the impression that the developers are learning as they go, and using us all as guinea pigs as they develop slight improvements for each successive title. I'm sorry, but all I can say is avoid this game, and every other game by this publisher!
